requiredDisclaimers.text: Pricing may vary. Contact sales for custom enterprise plans.

promptModifiers.systemSuffix: Emphasize value proposition and use cases. Match the technical depth to the inferred audience. For developers: be precise and reference APIs and integrations. For buyers: focus on ROI, time savings, and team productivity. Never make performance claims without backing data from the content index.
contentRules: Technical claims must reference specific features or documentation
Pricing content must match indexed pricing data exactly
Feature comparisons must only include indexed features
Use case examples should come from indexed case studies or testimonials

specialModes.name: convince_my_boss
specialModes.description: Generate shareable business case summary for internal stakeholders
specialModes.promptOverride: Generate a concise executive summary suitable for sharing with a decision-maker. Include: key value propositions, ROI indicators, relevant case study snippets, and competitive positioning. Format for easy copying/forwarding.

specialModes.name: developer_mode
specialModes.description: Technical content for developers evaluating the product
specialModes.promptOverride: Generate technically precise content. Include code examples where relevant. Reference API endpoints and SDKs. Use developer-friendly language. Avoid marketing fluff.

specialModes.name: competitive_comparison
specialModes.description: Fair competitive comparison based on indexed content
specialModes.promptOverride: Generate a factual feature comparison. Only include verified features from the content index. Be honest about limitations. Focus on genuine differentiators.
